historical_references.reference: Ibn al-Athir, Al-Kamel fi'l-Tarikh, vol. 3, p. 150-151. Sarfarazun, a Persian ruler, is mentioned as the one who defeated the Arab general, Al-Harith ibn Hisham, in 634 AD during the early Muslim conquests.

Al-Tabari, The History of al-Tabari, vol. 2, p. 227. Sarfarazun is identified as the ruler of the Persian province of Khuzestan and is mentioned for his military campaigns against the Byzantine Empire in the mid-7th century AD.
